name: Ecchi Oppai
description:
Meet cute girls who need your help finding their hearts. Think fast and don't get distracted, or you'll lose them forever.

Choose from a selection of pictures and help these girls find what they're looking for. If you're good enough, you'll even get a reward.

Features:
- Over 130 pictures of girls who need your help
- Local multiplayer mode for you and your friends
- Sensual music and sound effects 
- Simple and engaging gameplay
- A treat for your eyes

Can you find your way into their hearts?
